item.title: WhatsApp's 4 new group chat features (Oct 2026) and what works on Web
item.description: WhatsApp added forever pins, message history after joining, group status and a Mentions and replies filter on Oct 29, 2026. What each one does and which reach WhatsApp Web.

item.title: Dotted underline in WhatsApp messages? How to save a number or add a date to your calendar
item.description: WhatsApp now underlines phone numbers, dates, addresses and email addresses in chats. Here is what each shortcut does, how to save a number to your phone instead of only to WhatsApp, and what to do if you don't see it yet.

item.title: How to turn disappearing messages on or off in WhatsApp Web (and keep the messages you need)
item.description: Set a default message timer in WhatsApp Web, turn disappearing messages on or off in one chat or a group, and keep a message before its timer runs out.

item.title: How to lock WhatsApp Web with a password (and lock single chats too)
item.description: Turn on app lock in WhatsApp Web, pick when it locks itself, lock it on the spot with a shortcut, and use chat lock for the few chats you want hidden.

item.title: How to send message history to new WhatsApp group members (even after they join)
item.description: New WhatsApp group members start with an empty chat. Here's how to send them up to 100 recent messages when you add them or after they join, and what to do if you need more.

item.title: How to message yourself on WhatsApp Web (and keep that chat at the top)
item.description: Start a chat with yourself on WhatsApp Web, Android or iPhone, forward messages into it, pin it to the top, and see what the self-chat can't do.

item.title: How to add a cover photo to your WhatsApp profile, and who can see it
item.description: WhatsApp is testing profile cover photos for personal accounts on Android and iPhone. Here is how to add one, how to limit who sees it, and why the option may not show up for you yet.

item.title: How to find important messages buried in a WhatsApp group
item.description: Lost an important message in a busy WhatsApp group? Use the @ marker, the new Mentions and replies filter, in-chat search by keyword or date, stars and pins to find it.

item.title: How to mark a WhatsApp chat as unread on WhatsApp Web (and what the other person sees)
item.description: Read a WhatsApp message you can't answer yet? Mark the chat as unread on WhatsApp Web, Android or iPhone, do several chats at once, use the keyboard shortcut, and know what the sender still sees.

item.title: How to pin a WhatsApp message forever, and why old pins disappeared
item.description: WhatsApp now lets you keep a pinned message with no time limit. Here is how to pin and unpin on WhatsApp Web, Android and iPhone, who can pin in a group, and why some members can't see a pin.

item.title: Logged out of WhatsApp and your chats are gone? How to get them back
item.description: Logged out of WhatsApp, or logged back in to an empty chat list? What WhatsApp's help pages say about getting back in, restoring from a backup, and the one mistake that wipes old chats for good.

item.title: Where are starred messages on WhatsApp Web? How to star, find and unstar them
item.description: Starred a WhatsApp message and now can't find it? Here is where the Starred messages list is on WhatsApp Web, Android and iPhone, how to unstar one or all of them, and how to keep stars when you clear chats.

item.title: Can you delete multiple chats on WhatsApp Web? What works in 2026
item.description: WhatsApp Web deletes chats one at a time. Here is what WhatsApp's help pages say, where Delete all chats lives on the phone, and how to clear a crowded list without deleting.

item.title: Is that WhatsApp screenshot fake? How to check the actual chat
item.description: You usually can't prove a WhatsApp screenshot is real or fake from the image. Here's how to check the message itself, what the ticks, Info screen, edited and forwarded labels can tell you, and what to do when you can't verify it.

item.title: Where did my WhatsApp chat go? How to find and unarchive archived chats
item.description: A chat vanished from your WhatsApp list but nothing was deleted? It is probably archived. Here is where the Archived section is on WhatsApp Web, Android and iPhone, how to unarchive, and why archived chats stay hidden.

item.title: How to find an old photo, link or document someone sent you on WhatsApp
item.description: WhatsApp is building a media hub for iPhone. Until it ships, here is how to find a photo, link or file in your chats today, on phone and WhatsApp Web.

item.title: WhatsApp Web malware warning: how to check your linked devices
item.description: After Pakistan's NCERT warned of malware and hijacked WhatsApp Web sessions, here's how to check your linked devices, log out ones you don't know, and keep WhatsApp Web safe.

item.title: WhatsApp account restricted? Why WhatsApp Web stops working
item.description: A restricted WhatsApp account can't use linked devices, so WhatsApp Web and the desktop app stop working until the restriction ends. What it blocks, how to see the time left, and what to avoid.

item.title: Got a WhatsApp code you didn't ask for? What it means and what to do
item.description: An unrequested WhatsApp code means someone typed your number into the registration screen. What they can't do without it, how to get back in, and the settings that help.

item.title: Removed from the WhatsApp beta? How to rejoin on iPhone and Android
item.description: WhatsApp dropped a lot of iPhone testers from its TestFlight beta this week. Here is how the iOS and Android beta programs work, how to get back in, and how to avoid the invite-link scams.

item.title: WhatsApp Mentions and replies filter: find where you were tagged
item.description: WhatsApp's new Mentions and replies filter lists unread groups where you were tagged, replied to or @all'd. How it works, who has it, and how to find older mentions.

item.title: WhatsApp Restricted Chat: what it blocks on WhatsApp Web
item.description: WhatsApp's Restricted Chat beta blocks export, media auto-save, Meta AI and linked devices for one chat. What each limit means if you use WhatsApp Web, and how it differs from Advanced Chat Privacy.

item.title: WhatsApp taking up too much storage? How to free space that stays free
item.description: Find what's filling WhatsApp's storage, delete it in bulk without losing your messages, catch the copies WhatsApp leaves on your phone, and stop group media from piling up again.

item.title: India's SIM binding rule and WhatsApp Web: what changes
item.description: India's SIM binding rule for WhatsApp takes effect after the Dec 31, 2026 deadline. The six-hour WhatsApp Web logout was dropped for risk-based logouts. Here is what that means at a desk.

item.title: Ads in your WhatsApp Status? How to hide them, and what you can't switch off
item.description: Why ads now show up between Status updates, how to hide one ad or every ad from an advertiser, how to report scam ads, and what WhatsApp uses to pick them.

item.title: WhatsApp Web stuck on "Loading your chats"? What to try, in order
item.description: Why WhatsApp Web hangs on Loading your chats or keeps reloading, the fixes that work in the order worth trying them, and what to do when the problem follows your account to every browser.

item.title: Can you pin more than 3 chats on WhatsApp Web? The limit, and what to do instead
item.description: No. WhatsApp allows only three pinned chats, on WhatsApp Web and on the phone. How to pick the three, and where to put the rest: Lists or folders.

item.title: How to silence unknown callers on WhatsApp, and why some still ring
item.description: Turn on Silence unknown callers on Android and iPhone, find the calls it hid, and fix the cases where an unsaved number still rings. Plus the call filtering option WhatsApp is building.

item.title: Microsoft sent your verification code to WhatsApp? Why it happens and how to change it
item.description: Microsoft now delivers some sign-in codes through WhatsApp instead of SMS. How to tell the message is real, why you can't switch it off directly, and how to move your codes somewhere else.

item.title: WhatsApp daily backup not running on Android? How to check it and fix it
item.description: Your WhatsApp backup is set to Daily but only runs when you tap Back up. How to check when it last ran, why Android skips it, and fixes that won't put your chats at risk.
